title: What Baby Shower Planning Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of baby shower planning: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
A baby shower celebrates the parents-to-be with games, gifts, and food. Most happen 4-6 weeks before the due date, hosted by a friend or relative, with 15-30 guests.

Why it matters: Typical budget: $200-$600 for a home shower; venues run $500+ Send invitations 4-6 weeks ahead; RSVP deadline 2 weeks out

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.
facts: A baby shower celebrates the parents-to-be with games, gifts, and food. Most happen 4-6 weeks before the due date, hosted by a friend or relative, with 15-30 guests.
Typical budget: $200-$600 for a home shower; venues run $500+
Send invitations 4-6 weeks ahead; RSVP deadline 2 weeks out
Register for gifts early so guests have options at every price
Plan 3-4 games; each takes 10-15 minutes

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Baby Shower Planning
summary: Start baby shower planning this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Set the date 4-6 weeks before the due date
2. Build the guest list with the parents
3. Choose venue: home, restaurant, or park
4. Send invitations with registry links
5. Plan menu, cake, and decorations

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

Build the guest list with the parents
Choose venue: home, restaurant, or park
Send invitations with registry links
Plan menu, cake, and decorations

title: Baby Shower Planning Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common baby shower planning questions.
body:
Q: Who hosts?
A: Traditionally a friend or relative, not the parents themselves.

Q: Do I open gifts at the party?
A: Yes at most showers; have someone record each gift for thank-you notes.

Q: Can it be co-ed?
A: Yes - co-ed 'baby-Qs' are increasingly common.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.
